AppConfig.description: Public, unauthenticated: what the UI needs before login and for forms.
AppConfig.title: AppConfig

base_version.description: 0 to create; otherwise the current version
base_version.title: Base Version

GateInfo.description: The human gate after a stage (`gate_after`). `person` is who it waits on (`waiting` only).
GateInfo.title: GateInfo

ImportRequest.description: A source ticket to import: a Jira key (`SCRUM-6`) or its browse link.
ImportRequest.title: ImportRequest

ImportResult.description: `created: false` = the issue was imported before; `ticket` is that ticket.
ImportResult.title: ImportResult

IntakeAssignee.description: A Jira assignee: a Jira account, not (necessarily) an AgentOS user.
IntakeAssignee.title: IntakeAssignee

IntakeItem.title: IntakeItem

IntakePreview.description:
POST /api/settings/intake/preview ("Test query"): live, not cached. The same filtering and
error messages as GET /api/intake, at most 5 items; `total` counts every candidate.
IntakePreview.title: IntakePreview

IntakeQuery.description:
One `[[intake.queries]]` entry with its current candidates, newest-updated first, capped.
`total` = how many candidates the JQL has (exact up to the fetch window, else estimated from
Jira's approximate count). A failing query has `error` (a short message) and no items.
IntakeQuery.title: IntakeQuery

IntakeQueryIn.description: `id: null` = a new query: the server makes a unique id from its name. Sent ids are kept.
IntakeQueryIn.title: IntakeQueryIn

IntakeQuerySpec.description: One intake query: a JQL whose matches the Intake tab lists (request 14).
IntakeQuerySpec.title: IntakeQuerySpec

IntakeSettings.description: Settings > Intake: the queries, in tab order.
IntakeSettings.title: IntakeSettings

IntakeSettingsUpdate.description:
PUT /api/settings/intake. The JQL isn't checked against Jira (it might be down): use the
preview. Saving drops the intake cache.
IntakeSettingsUpdate.title: IntakeSettingsUpdate

LoginRequest.description: Cloud: email + token. Data Center: token. Dev auth: username.
LoginRequest.title: LoginRequest

NowInfo.description:
Server-written "Now / Next" line. The UI renders it; it never derives it.

`actor` is a non-human label only (the running stage, later "CI" or "Queue"). `person` is who
the ticket waits on: the owner today; approver, human-stage assignee or PR reviewer later.
e.g. running:   actor="Implement", run_id=42, text="Run API test suite"
                → "Implement · run #42 · …"
     queued:    run_id=42, text="queued for a runner"
     blocked:   run_id=42, text="Review failed: retry or adjust"
     needs_you: person=None, text="review plan and continue" → "Waiting on you · …"
     waiting:   person=Sam, text="review plan and continue"  → "Waiting on Sam Lee · …"
     inbox:     run_id=None, text="add context, then dispatch"
NowInfo.title: NowInfo

PhaseStep.description: Board-level progress: one entry per Phase, always all six, in order.
PhaseStep.title: PhaseStep

PlanItem.description: One checklist line of TASKS.md (`- [ ] text` / `- [x] text`), text stripped.
PlanItem.title: PlanItem

RailStep.description:
Stage-level progress: every stage of the ticket's pipeline, in order (disabled ones
`skipped`). `gate` is set on every enabled stage with `gate_after`.
RailStep.title: RailStep

RepoEntryIn.description: `url`: https://..., ssh://... or git@host:path (GitHub Actions runners: https).
RepoEntryIn.title: RepoEntryIn

RepoInfo.description: One entry of the Space's repo catalog (Settings > Repos).
RepoInfo.title: RepoInfo

RepoSettings.description:
Settings > Repos: the Space's repo catalog. Tickets reference a repo by name, so changing a
URL or default branch reaches every ticket that uses it.
RepoSettings.title: RepoSettings

RepoSettingsUpdate.description:
PUT /api/settings/repos: the whole catalog, in order. Names are unique and can't be renamed
(a missing name = removed, a new one = added). Removing a repo that open tickets or the
Space's `default_repo` use → 409 `in_use`; done and closed tickets keep the name.
RepoSettingsUpdate.title: RepoSettingsUpdate

Resolution.description: How a ticket was closed, and by whom. Cleared by any PATCH that changes `state`.
Resolution.title: Resolution

ResolveRequest.description: POST /api/tickets/{key}/resolve. `note` is stripped; blank → null. Not a chat message.
ResolveRequest.title: ResolveRequest

RunnerSettings.description:
Settings > Runners: where `AGENTOS_LAUNCHER=github` dispatches each run's workflow. Read at
every launch (no restart). `launcher` (AGENTOS_LAUNCHER) and `token_set` (AGENTOS_GITHUB_TOKEN
is set) come from the server's env and are read-only. `github_repo` null = none set: with the
github launcher, runs then fail at launch saying so.
RunnerSettings.title: RunnerSettings

RunnerSettingsUpdate.description:
PUT /api/settings/runner. `github_repo`: `owner/name` or null; `workflow`: a .yml file name
in that repo's .github/workflows/; `ref`: the branch or tag the workflow file is on.
RunnerSettingsUpdate.title: RunnerSettingsUpdate

RuntimeEntry.description:
One agent runtime: how a stage's argv is built (SPEC §7). `argv`, then `model_args` when a
model resolves, `agent_args` when the stage names an agent, then `prompt_args` when
`prompt_via` is "arg" (else the prompt is the stdin). The placeholders `{model}`, `{agent}`
and `{prompt}` replace whole elements; no shell is involved. `prompt_via: "arg"` needs
`prompt_args` containing "{prompt}"; "stdin" takes no `prompt_args`.
RuntimeEntry.title: RuntimeEntry

RuntimeSettings.description:
Settings > Runners (runtimes). The first runtime is the server default: what an agent stage
runs on when neither it nor the template's `defaults` names one.
RuntimeSettings.title: RuntimeSettings

RuntimeSettingsUpdate.description:
PUT /api/settings/runtimes: the whole list, in order (the first = the server default).
Names are unique. Removing a runtime the current template's `defaults` or stages use → 409
`in_use` (a ticket's own stage pinned to it fails when dispatched).
RuntimeSettingsUpdate.title: RuntimeSettingsUpdate

SpaceSettings.description:
Settings > Space. `key_prefix` only affects new native tickets (stored keys never change).
`jira_projects`: signing in needs browse access to one of them (AGENTOS_ADMINS people
excepted); imports and intake only take issues from them.
SpaceSettings.title: SpaceSettings

SpaceSettingsUpdate.description:
PUT /api/settings/space. 422 `validation_error` when `default_repo` isn't a configured repo,
`key_prefix` is one of `jira_projects` (native keys would take real Jira keys), a project
repeats, or `jira_projects` is empty while sign-in is with Jira.
SpaceSettingsUpdate.title: SpaceSettingsUpdate

StreamEvent.description: Payload of each `data:` line on GET /api/stream. Notifications only: refetch on receipt.
StreamEvent.title: StreamEvent

TemplateDefaults.description:
The Space-wide defaults for agent stages, as the admin set them (null = not set). A stage's
own `runtime` / `model` wins; unset here → the server default runtime (the first in
Settings > Runners) / no model. `runtime` must be a configured runtime (422
`validation_error`).
TemplateDefaults.title: TemplateDefaults

TemplateUpdate.description:
PUT: `pipeline` and `scaffold` replace the current ones. `defaults` omitted = keep the
current defaults (explicit null is rejected); send `{}` or nulls to clear them.
TemplateUpdate.title: TemplateUpdate

TicketPatch.description:
`repo` (null = no-repo mode), `base_branch` (null = the repo's default) and `owner_id` may
be null; others: omit or set.
TicketPatch.title: TicketPatch

get.description:
Each configured intake query with the Jira issues it matches that aren't in AgentOS yet
(newest-updated first, capped). "Take in" one with POST /api/tickets/import.

Jira's answers are cached ~45 s; `fresh=1` (Retry, Refresh) refetches every query that wasn't
fetched in the last few seconds.

schema.title: Response List Intake Api Intake Get

get.description: Works for a `pending` user too, so the UI can show the waiting-for-approval page.
Everyone who can be a ticket owner or be mentioned (any signed-in user may list).

schema.title: Response List People Api People Get
Response Run Events Api Runs  Run Id  Events Get

get.description: Exactly what was sent to the worker (prompts + files). Can be large; fetch on demand.

post.description:
Test a JQL before saving it: live (never cached), at most 5 items, with the same filtering
and error messages as GET /api/intake.

schema.title: Response List Tickets Api Tickets Get

post.description:
Import a Jira issue by key or browse link: 201 with `created: true`, or 200 with
`created: false` and the ticket it was imported as before.

schema.title: Response List Chat Api Tickets  Key  Chat Get
Response List Files Api Tickets  Key  Files Get

post.description:
Close the ticket: `completed` → state done, `abandoned` → state closed (both stay on the
board as `done`). 409 `run_active` during a run. Reopen with PATCH `state: open`.

schema.title: Response List Runs Api Tickets  Key  Runs Get
Response List Versions Api Tickets  Key  Versions  Path  Get
Response List Users Api Users Get
